strategy: API/registry metadata first; local CSS transposition instead of framework-incompatible copy

selected_patterns.name: Magnetic Button
selected_patterns.use_in_paganelli: Translated to dependency-free CSS as a tactile offset/shadow response on the existing rectangular editorial buttons. No magnetic cursor displacement was copied because it conflicts with the restrained 1950s-almanac direction.

selected_patterns.name: Book A Call Button
selected_patterns.use_in_paganelli: Used as interaction reference for the phone CTA: stable label, contained icon and short transform feedback, implemented locally in CSS.

selected_patterns.name: Scroll Reveal Content A
selected_patterns.use_in_paganelli: Its synchronized number/text/image principle informed the rebuilt pastry scene. Implementation stays in the site's existing IntersectionObserver system and respects reduced motion.

selected_patterns.name: Scroll Reveal Image
selected_patterns.use_in_paganelli: Adapted as a rightward cake arrival with settling rotation/scale and drop-shadow depth; no generic rounded-card expansion was imported.

selected_patterns.name: Floating Action Button
selected_patterns.use_in_paganelli: Used only as a containment reference. The local WhatsApp action now has a white inset brand-glyph disc, restrained elevation, 62px mobile target and no external dependency.
